was: City of Dearborn-owned recreation area (626 acres) in Milford, open to the public. Transient campground has 191 nightly sites: ~96 full-hookup (water/sewer/20-30-50-amp, to 45 ft) and ~95 electric-only (20-amp, to 35 ft); a 23-ft rig fits either. Reservable nightly online via Campspot; full season May 1-Nov 1 (peak mid-June to mid-Aug). Separate ~450-site permanent/seasonal trailer area and cabins also on site.
